Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity export for upcoming SIG / SOC 2 audit

Hi Neha,

We have an upcoming SIG / SOC 2 audit and the auditor asked for a full export of admin activity (operator/admin actions, role/grant changes, console logins, API key rotations) covering the last 13 months. Key asks from the auditor:
- a machine-readable export (CSV or Parquet) with "event_id", "actor_email", "actor_role", "action", "resource", "timestamp_iso", and "request_ip"
- timestamps normalized to UTC with timezone metadata noted
- a signed manifest (SHA256) and chain-of-custody statement
- redacted PII option for any email addresses upon request
- delivery via SFTP (preferred) or presigned S3 URLs; must support server-side encryption and an auditor-managed SSH key

Can you confirm what you can provide, estimated time to deliver a sample extract, and any constraints (retention window, sampling, or field redaction limitations)? Attaching the SIG questionnaire section that references admin activity.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Moreno
Security & Compliance Program Manager

Forwarding Novothera's ask — auditor wants a 13-month admin-activity export with manifest and chain-of-custody. Questions for ops/compliance:
- Format: CSV (flat, easy) vs Parquet (schema-preserving, smaller). Parquet preferred for large volumes but may require a manifest + schema file.
- Delivery: They prefer SFTP with their auditor key. Alternate is presigned S3 URLs with one-time tokens.
- Redaction: We can hash emails (sha256) and keep a mapping internally if required under NDA.
- Sampling: Auditor asked for full 13 months, but we could offer a 30-day sample first.

Ben/Kim — can you confirm:
1) estimated job runtime and size (rough) for 13 months of admin logs for a single-account export;
2) whether we can produce a signed manifest and include per-file checksums + overall HMAC;
3) whether timestamps can be normalized to UTC and include timezone metadata in the manifest;

I'll propose 3 business days for a sample once we agree the format.

-Neha

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: admin activity export for upcoming SIG / SOC 2 audit

High level plan and constraints: (draft)

1) Format: produce Parquet files partitioned by month + a gzipped archive. Reasons: preserves types, smaller transfer, schema in _metadata. We'll include a companion CSV extract for quick human review.

2) Fields preserved: event_id, actor_email (we can provide both raw and hashed columns), actor_role, action, resource_path, timestamp_iso (ISO8601, normalized to UTC), request_ip, session_id, request_user_agent.

3) Timestamps: all normalized to UTC; manifest will include exporter timezone (UTC) and original event timezone if available.

4) Checksums & signing: each file will have a SHA256 checksum recorded in manifest. We will produce an overall signed manifest (RSA 2048 signature / detached) and an HMAC for sequence validation.

5) Delivery options:
   - Preferred: Auditor-managed SFTP (we upload archive to their SFTP using their public key)
   - Alternate: Presigned S3 URLs (72h validity) and single-use download tokens.

6) Redaction: PII hashing available (sha256) + reversible mapping stored in an encrypted internal key store (available under NDA). If Novothera requests non-reversible redaction, we can provide that too but note it will remove email plaintext.

7) Retention & scope: Our native retention is 24 months; we can carve out the requested 13-month slice. We recommend delivering the full 13 months rather than a sampled subset.

8) Timeline & sample: We can produce a 30-day sample (Parquet + manifest) within 2 business days; full 13-month package in 5 business days once a delivery method is agreed.

Attachments: export_plan_outline.md (high-level checklist + steps). Costs: small egress fee if using SFTP to external host; we'll confirm pricing with ops.

-ben
Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Evidence & Exports
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: export_plan_outline.md]
